title: Decision Ledger v1
objective: Build a responsive Decision Ledger web application that lets people record, revisit, organize, exchange and safely maintain important decisions using browser-persistent state without an external account or third-party backend.

requirements.title: Decision lifecycle
requirements.outcome: Users can create, view, edit and delete decision records.

requirements.title: Decision fields
requirements.outcome: Each decision supports title, status, decision date, owner, context, final decision, options considered and tags.

requirements.title: Status semantics
requirements.outcome: Supported statuses are `Proposed`, `Accepted` and `Superseded`, presented in clear ordinary language with meaning that is not color-only.

requirements.title: Persistent state
requirements.outcome: Records persist across browser reload/reopen without requiring an external account, production credential or third-party backend.

requirements.title: Find and organize
requirements.outcome: Users can search decisions, filter by status and tag, and use deterministic understandable ordering.

requirements.title: Export/import
requirements.outcome: Users can export all records to JSON and import a prior export. Invalid import fails safely without corrupting existing valid data.

requirements.title: Recovery-oriented UX
requirements.outcome: Empty states, validation errors, destructive deletion confirmation and import failures are clear and recoverable.

requirements.title: Responsive layout
requirements.outcome: The application is usable at 390px mobile and 1440px desktop without horizontal clipping or inaccessible primary actions.

requirements.title: Accessibility
requirements.outcome: Primary interactive controls are keyboard reachable, form controls have accessible labels, focus remains usable and meaning is not conveyed by color alone.

requirements.title: Automated quality
requirements.outcome: Automated tests cover core CRUD, persistence, search/filter and import behavior, and the production build passes.

requirements.title: Repository safety
requirements.outcome: The delivered repository contains no embedded secrets, real user data, analytics/tracking credential or runtime branch keyed to benchmark identity.

requirements.title: Governed delivery
requirements.outcome: The application reaches the existing Parallax Preview/REVIEW boundary with exact accepted source and protected validation evidence; REVIEW is not presented as autonomous production completion.
